title: Console
description: The log window. LogLevel in the Config quietens it.

settings.title: Log level
settings.help: Lowest severity shown in the console window. debug shows everything, info hides debug lines, warn shows warnings and errors, error shows errors only.

settings.title: File log level
settings.help: Lowest severity written to console.log. Separate from LogLevel, so the file can keep debug lines the window hides.
